blockingFindings.title: R4 halt context does not assert non-reflection reason
blockingFindings.issue: R4 requires the preflight failure envelope or prompt context to include the required file path, detected status, reason it will not be reflected in the worktree, and recovery choices. The shared assertion checks only the path, a status token, and commit/abort recovery words, so an implementation could omit the required non-reflection reason and still pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Extend the halt assertion to require text or structured data explaining that the detected `.senti/config.json` state will not be reflected in the new worktree checkout.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is an explicit acceptance requirement with no executable coverage in the spec-local tests.

advisoryFindings.title: R5 behavior coverage is partially shallow
advisoryFindings.improvement: Consider asserting evidence of plugin runtime sync in addition to worktree creation, spec artifacts, docs analysis, and local overlay sync.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The test covers the core success path and several listed artifacts; plugin runtime sync verification would improve confidence but is not necessary to make the current test suite executable or valid.
